name: 168. Reasoning-only models forced to Responses (reasoning-only-to-responses)
description:
The compat toggle force_reasoning_only_models_to_responses (on by default) routes /v1/chat/completions requests to the Responses API for models whose datasheet sets supports_reasoning_with_tool_calls: false, such as GPT-6 Sol. Before it existed, compat kept these requests on chat completions and turned reasoning off (dropped, or set to none) whenever tools were present. The plugin marks ChangeRequestType=ResponsesRequest whether or not tools are attached; core converts with ToResponsesRequest() keeping the caller's reasoning object (no reasoning.summary default is added for OpenAI; only Bedrock and Bedrock Mantle narrow a summary to auto), calls OpenAI Responses, and maps the result back to chat. Every case sends the targeted x-bf-compat header and reads extra_fields.raw_request to check what Bifrost sent.

168.1 pins the non-streaming tool route: converted, effort high kept, any summary a valid value, tool call mapped back. 168.2 is the streaming variant. 168.3 pins conversion without tools. 168.4 pins that a model without the flag (gpt-4o-mini) stays on chat completions.
